743	def filter_snooze(*, db_session: Session, signal_instance: SignalInstance) -> SignalInstance:
744	    """
745	    Apply snooze filter actions to the signal instance.
746	
747	    Args:
748	        db_session (Session): Database session.
749	        signal_instance (SignalInstance): Signal instance to be filtered.
750	
751	    Returns:
752	        SignalInstance: The filtered signal instance.
753	    """
754	    for f in signal_instance.signal.filters:
755	        if f.mode != SignalFilterMode.active or f.action != SignalFilterAction.snooze:
756	            continue
757	
758	        if not f.expiration:
759	            log.warning(f"Signal filter {f.name} has no expiration date")
760	            continue
761	
762	        if f.expiration.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) <= datetime.now(timezone.utc):
763	            break
764	
765	        query = db_session.query(SignalInstance).filter(
766	            SignalInstance.signal_id == signal_instance.signal_id
767	        )
768	        query = apply_filter_specific_joins(SignalInstance, f.expression, query)
769	        query = apply_filters(query, f.expression)
770	        # an expression is not required for snoozing, if absent we snooze regardless of entity
771	        if f.expression:
772	            instances = query.filter(SignalInstance.id == signal_instance.id).all()
773	
774	            if instances:
775	                signal_instance.filter_action = SignalFilterAction.snooze
776	                break
777	        else:
778	            signal_instance.filter_action = SignalFilterAction.snooze
779	            break
780	
781	    return signal_instance

def test_filter_actions_snooze(session, entity, signal, project):
    from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
    from dispatch.signal.models import SignalFilterAction
    from dispatch.signal.service import filter_signal
    from tests.factories import EntityTypeFactory, SignalInstanceFactory, SignalFilterFactory

    entity_type = EntityTypeFactory(project=project)
    session.add(entity_type)
    signal.entity_types.append(entity_type)

    session.add(entity)

    # create instance
    signal_instance_1 = SignalInstanceFactory(
        project=project,
        signal=signal,
        entities=[entity],
        raw=json.dumps({"id": "foo"}),
    )
    session.add(signal_instance_1)
    session.commit()

    signal_filter = SignalFilterFactory(
        name="snooze0",
        description="test",
        expression=[{"or": [{"model": "Entity", "field": "id", "op": "==", "value": entity.id}]}],
        action="snooze",
        expiration=datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(minutes=5),
        project=project,
    )

    signal.filters = [signal_filter]

    session.commit()
    assert filter_signal(db_session=session, signal_instance=signal_instance_1)
    assert signal_instance_1.filter_action == SignalFilterAction.snooze

def test_filter_actions_snooze_expired_and_active(session, entity, signal, project):
    from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
    from dispatch.signal.models import SignalFilterAction
    from dispatch.signal.service import filter_signal
    from tests.factories import EntityTypeFactory, SignalInstanceFactory, SignalFilterFactory

    entity_type = EntityTypeFactory(project=project)
    session.add(entity_type)
    signal.entity_types.append(entity_type)
    session.add(entity)

    signal_instance_1 = SignalInstanceFactory(
        project=project,
        signal=signal,
        entities=[entity],
        raw=json.dumps({"id": "foo"}),
    )
    session.add(signal_instance_1)
    session.commit()

    expression = [{"or": [{"model": "Entity", "field": "id", "op": "==", "value": entity.id}]}]
    expired_filter = SignalFilterFactory(
        name="snooze_expired",
        description="test",
        expression=expression,
        action="snooze",
        expiration=datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=7),
        project=project,
    )
    active_filter = SignalFilterFactory(
        name="snooze_active",
        description="test",
        expression=expression,
        action="snooze",
        expiration=datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=30),
        project=project,
    )

    # the expired filter comes first and must not stop evaluation of the active one
    signal.filters = [expired_filter, active_filter]
    session.commit()
    assert filter_signal(db_session=session, signal_instance=signal_instance_1)
    assert signal_instance_1.filter_action == SignalFilterAction.snooze

Fixed. In `filter_snooze` (`src/dispatch/signal/service.py`), an expired snooze filter ended the whole loop with `break`. Any valid filter listed after it was never checked, so instances stopped being snoozed. It now uses `continue`, so expired filters are skipped and the rest are still evaluated.

I added a regression test, `test_filter_actions_snooze_expired_and_active`, in `tests/signal/test_signal_service.py`. It puts an expired filter ahead of an active one for the same entity and expects the instance to be snoozed. It fails without the fix and passes with it. The rest of the signal service tests pass.
